title: [GMCP 203.022.06] Operations and evidence: Namespacing, routing, composition, and virtual capabilities
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-022-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: Stable globally unique capability identities prevent collisions and shadowing across servers, aliases remain explicit, and routing can select or fan out by schema, policy, health, locality and cost. Typed compositions form virtual tools/resources/prompts with provenance, transaction and compensation semantics, cycle detection, bounded depth, deterministic plans, and no privilege amplification between steps. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
